claim: 최종적으로 회개하지 않는 자들은 하나님의 의로움을 위해 제물이 되어야 하며, 그들의 멸망은 하나님의 공의를 보여주는 예가 된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If the grand end of future punishment be example, this must sup- pose the existence of an intelligent creation, who shall profit by it; and it should seem of a creation of magnitude ; as it accords with the conduct of neither God nor man to punish a great number for an example to a few.
claim: 미래의 형벌의 궁극적인 목적이 예시라면, 이는 지능적인 창조물의 존재를 전제로 하며, 이 창조물은 그 예시를 통해 이익을 얻을 것이며, 또한 상당한 규모의 창조물을 전제로 하는 것으로 보인다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: This truth affords a satisfactory idea of the divine government, whether there be a multiplicity of inhabited worlds or not : but if there be, it is still more satisfactory ; as on this supposition the number of those who shall be finally lost may bear far less propor- tion to the whole of the intelligent creation, than a single execu- tion to the inhabitants of agreat empire.
claim: 신의 정부는 다중의 거주 가능한 세계가 존재하는지 여부에 관계없이 만족할 만한 아이디어를 제공하며, 만약 그런 세계가 존재한다면, 최종적으로 잃어버린 사람들의 수는 지적 창조물 전체에 비해 더 적은 비율을 차지할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is true, the loss to those who are lost will be nothing abated by this consideration; per- haps, on the contrary, it may be augmented ; and to them the divine government will ever appear gloomy ; but to those who iudge of things impartially, and upon an extensive scale, it will ap- pear to contain no more of a disparagement to the government of the universe, than the execution of a murderer, once in a hun- dred years, would be to the goverment of a nation.
claim: 신의 정부는 지혜롭고 공의로우며, 심판의 대상이 되는 자들에게는 어둡게 보일 수 있지만, 공평한 판단을 하는 사람들에게는 정부의 명예에 대한 손상을 주지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: to admit " that God created a plurality of worlds, at least as nu- merous as what we call stars, renders the Christian system of faith at once little and ridiculous, and scatters it in the mind like fea- thers in the air." On the contrary, it might be proved, that every ?ystem of philosophy is little in comparison of Christianity.
claim: 하나님의 창조가 다중 우주를 포함한다는 것은 기독교 신앙 체계를 작고 우스꽝스럽게 만들 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Phi- losophy may expand our ideas of creation ; but it neither inspires a love to the moral character of the Creator, nor a well-grounded hope of eternal life.
claim: 철학은 창조에 대한 우리의 아이디어를 확장할 수 있지만, 창조자의 도덕적 성격에 대한 사랑이나 영원한 생명에 대한 잘 근거된 희망을 불어넣지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Philosophy at most can only place us at the top of Pisgah : there, like Moses we must die : it gives us no pos- sessions of the good land.
claim: 철학은 창조에 대한 우리의 아이디어를 확장할 수 있지만, 창조주의 도덕적 성품에 대한 사랑이나 영원한 생명에 대한 잘 기반을 둔 희망을 불어넣지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is the province of Christianity to add, All is youns !
claim: 기독교는 인간의 발견을 넘어서는 무한한 중요성을 가진 것들을 제공한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: When you have ascended to the height of hu- man discovery, there are things, and things of infinite moment too, that are utterly beyond its reach.
claim: 인간의 발견과 지식에는 한계가 있으며, 무한한 중요성을 가진 것들이 인간의 이해력을 넘어서는 것들이 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Revelation is the medium, and the only medium, by which, standing, as it were, " on na- ture's Alps," we discover things which eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, and of which it never hath entered into <he heart of raan to conceive.
claim: 계시는 인간이 자연을 통해 알 수 없는 것들을 발견할 수 있는 유일한 수단이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: In the former part of this performance, I have endeavoured to prove, that the system which you embrace overlooks the moral character of God, refuses to worship him, affords no standard of right and wrong, undermines the most efficacious motives to vir- tuous action, actually produces a torrent of vice, and leaves man- kind, under all their miseries, to perish without hope; in fine, that it is an immoral system, pregnant with destruction to the hu- man race.
claim: 제시된 신학적 체계는 하나님의 도덕적 성품을 간과하며, 도덕적 기준을 제공하지 않고, 악행을 조장하며, 결국 인류에게 파멸을 가져다준다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: To em- brace a system of immorality is the same thing as to be enemies to all righteousness ; neither to fear God, nor regard man ; and what good fruit you can expect to reap from it, in this world or another, it is difficult to conceive.
claim: 불道덕적인 체계를 받아들이는 것은 모든 정의에 대한 적으로 되는 것과 같으며, 하나님을 두려워하지도 않고 사람을 존중하지도 않으며, 이 세계나 다른 세계에서 어떤 좋은 열매를 기대할 수 있는지 이해하기 어렵다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But alas, instead of being alarmed at the immorality of your principles, is there no reason to suspect that it is on this very account you cherish them ?
claim: 불道덕적인 원칙을 지지하는 것은 그 자체로 모든 정의에 대한 적개심을 의미하며, 하나님을 두려워하지도 않고 사람을 존중하지도 않으며, 이 세계나 다른 세계에서 어떤 좋은 열매를 기대할 수 있는지 이해하기 어렵다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You can occasionally praise the morality of Jesus Christ : but are you sincere ?
claim: 예수 그리스도의 도덕을 간혹 칭찬할 수 있지만, 그럴 때마다 진정성 있게 하는가?

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Why" then do you not walk by it ?
claim: 그리스도의 도덕을 칭찬할 수 있지만, 그분의 가르침을 실제로 따르는가?

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: However you may mag- nify other difficulties, which you have industriously laboured to discover in the bible, your actions declare that it is the holiness of its doctrines and precepts, that more than any thing else of- fends you.
claim: 성경의 교리와 계명의 거룩함이 다른 어려움보다도 더 사람들을 불편하게 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The manifest object at which you aim, both for your- selves and the world, is an exemption from its restraints.
claim: 성경의 가르침과 계명의 거룩함이 사람들을 제한한다는 것이 그들에게 가장 거슬리는 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Your general conduct, if put into words, amounts to this : Come let us break his bands, and cast away his cords from us.
claim: 하나님의 제한을 거부하고 그분의 규칙에서 벗어나고자 하는 태도

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You are great, you are enlightened; yes, you have found out the secret, and have only to rid the world of Christianity in order to render it happ}^.
claim: 기독교를 없애면 세상을幸福하게 할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You are not the first who have set themselves against the Lord, and against his Anointed.
claim: 주님과 그의 기름 받은 자를 대적하는 것은 새로운 것이 아님을 인정하라

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You have have overthrown superstition; but vaunt not against Christianity.
claim: 기독교에 대한 자랑이나 도전보다는 우상숭배를 무너뜨린 것에 만족해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Of a truth you have destroyed the gods of Rome, for they were no gods; but let this suffice you.
claim: 로마의 신들을 파괴했지만 기독교에 대하여는 자랑하지 말라

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is hard to kick against the pricks.
claim: 하나님께 대항하는 것은 어려운 일이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Whatever success may attend yotir cause, if it be an immoral one, and espoused on that very account, it cannot possibly stand.
claim: 불법적인 목적을 위해 추구하는 일은 결국 실패할 수밖에 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It must fall, and you may expect to be buried in its ruins.
claim: 불법적인 원인에 기인하는 성공은 반드시 실패로 끝난다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Nor is there any hope of your unbelief being remo- ved, but by something that shall reach the cause of it.
claim: 불신은 그 원인이 해결되지 않는 한 제거될 수 없다

author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: js neither to insult nor flatter, but seriously to expostulate with you; if God peradventure may give you repentance to the ac- knowledgment of the truth.
claim: 신자는 진지하게 진리를 인정하고 회개하기 위해 하나님의 은혜를 받기를 바랍니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: How it was that you first imbibed your present principles; How it is that al- most all your writers, at one time or other, bear testimony in favour of Christianity; and, How it comes to pass that your principles fail you, as they are frequently known to do, in a dying hour ?
claim: 그들의 현재 원칙을 처음 어떻게 받아들였는지, 거의 모든 작가들이 어느 시점에든 기독교를 위해 증언하는지, 그리고 그들의 원칙이 죽음의 순간에 실패하는 이유는 무엇인지

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Nothing is more common than for per- sons of relaxed morals to attribute their change of conduct to a change of sentiments, or views relative to those subjects.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is galling to one's own feelings, and mean in the account of others, to act against pririciple; but if a person can once persuade himself to think favourably of those things which he has formerly account- ed sinful, and can furnish a plea for them, which, at least, may serve to parry the censures of mankind, he will feel much more at ease, and be able to put 011 a better face when he mingles in socie- ty.
claim: 사람이 자신의 행동을 정당화하기 위해 이전에 죄악이라고 생각했던 것에 대해 긍정적인 생각을 가지게 되면, 그는 더 편안하게 느끼고 사회에서 더 나은 얼굴을 할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Did you not, previously to your rejection of Christianity, indulge in vicious courses; and while indulging in iliese courses, did not its holy pre- cepts, and awful threatenings gall your spirits ?
claim: 기독교를 거부하기 전에, 사람들은 종종 그들의 죄악적인 행동으로 인해 성경의 가르침과 경고가 그들의 영을 괴롭혔으며, 이러한 고통으로부터 벗어나기 위해 유신론적인 원칙을 찾았다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Were you not like persons gathering forbidden fruit amidst showers of arrows: and had you not recourse to your present principles for a shield against them ? if you cannot honestly answer these ques- tions in the negative, you lue in an evil cause.
claim: 기독교를 거부한 사람들은 이전에 부도덕한 행동에 빠져 있었고, 그 행동을 하면서 기독교의 경건한 교훈과 무서운 경고가 그들의 영을 괴롭혔으며, 현재의 원칙을 방패로 사용하여 그들을 대적했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You may flatter yourselves, for a while, that perhaps there may be no hereafter, or at least no judgment to come; but you know the time is npt far
claim: 지금은 후회 없이 살 수 있을지라도, 언젠가는 심판을 받게 될 것이라는 사실을 알면서도 현재의 원칙을 방패로 사용하여 죄를 지을 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Has not your infidelity arisen from the dis- like which you conceived in early life to religious exercises ?
claim: 종교적 실천에 대한 초기의 불쾌감이 불신으로 이어진다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Family worship was a weariness to you; and the cautions, warn- ings and counsels which were given you, instead of having any pro- per effect, only irritated your corruptions.
claim: 가정 예배와 경고,警告, 조언은 오히려 부패를 자극했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You longed to be from under the yoke.
claim: 당신은 하나님의 말씀과 경건한 삶의 규율에서 벗어나고 싶어했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You have long suspected the truth of Christianity; but had not courage to oppose it.
claim: 기독교의 진리는 오랫동안 의심되어 왔지만, 그것에 반대하기에는 용기가 없었음

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The Supreme Being (if there be one,) can never have created the pleasures of life, but for the pur- pose of enjoyment.
claim: 최고의 존재는 삶의 즐거움을 즐기기 위한 목적으로 창조했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: And are you now satisfied ? 1 do not ask whether you have been able to defend your cause agiiinst assailants, nor whether you have gained converts to your way of thinking: you may have done both; but are you satisfied with yourselves ?
claim: 자기 자신에 대해 만족하는가?

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Do you really believe yourselves to be in the right way ?
claim: 진정으로 자신들이 올바른 길에 있는지 믿는가?

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Is there not something within you which occasionally whispers, ' My parents were righteous, and I am wicked: O that my soul were in their souls' stead ?'
claim: 어떤 사람들은 자신이 악하고 부모가 의로운 것에 대해 가끔씩 마음속에서 고민한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If such be the occasional revoltings of your mind, what are you doing in labouring to gain others over to your way of thinking ?
claim: 만약 당신의 마음에 가끔 이런 반란적인 생각이 들면, 왜 당신은 다른 사람들을 당신의 생각방식으로 끌어들이려고 노력하는가?

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Can you from experience honestly promise them peace of mind ?
claim: 경험적으로 평안을 약속할 수 있는가?

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If Christianity should prove what your consciences in your most serious moments fell you it is, you are doing this every day of your lives.
claim: 그리스도교가 당신們의 양심에서 가장 심각한 순간에 느끼는 것과 같다면, 당신們은 매일 그리스도교의 가치를 실천하지 않고 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It wcrc Gasy to collect from those very writings which were designetl to undermine the Christian religion, hun- dreds of testimonies in its favour.
claim: 기독교를 비판하는 글들에서도 기독교를 지지하는 수백개의 증거를 수집할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Bolingbroke has done the same.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: " He was," says he, " a vir- tuous and an amiable man.
claim: 예수 그리스도는 덕망이 있고 사랑받을 만한 사람이었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Is it not an unfavourable character of your cause, that in this particular, it exactly resembles that of vice itself?
claim: 악한 행동이나 가치가 옹호되는 경우에는 그 옹호가 악한 본질을 드러내는 것과 유사한 특징을 보인다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Vicious men will often bear testimony in favour of virtue, especially on the near approach of death ; but virtuous men never return the compliment by bearing testimony in favour of vice.
claim: 덕 있는 사람들은 악행을 옹호하는 증언을 결코 하지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 3: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
